notes.title: [Update] Dual Guns Are Here! – Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680818/0b73a3a09ee08ddac967d9ad551c1325928fd893.png"][/img][/p][h3]Hello, Survivors!
This is [b]Jebi[/b], CM of the [b]The DeadLine[/b] development team.[/h3][p][/p][p]Welcome to [b]Patch 1.2.0[/b], the update that makes zombies tremble![/p][p][/p][p]This patch brings [b]new dual firearms[/b] and [b]a new language[/b] support.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Weapons Added[/h2][p][/p][p][i]“The new weapons will help you survive even longer.[/i][/p][p][i]Performance guaranteed by [b]Rotten Apple Company[/b]!”[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]UZK - 18[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]MXR - 30[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]New Language Support[/h2][p][/p][p][i]“Special thanks to everyone who helped with the Brazilian Portuguese localization.”[/i][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]The DeadLine[/b] now supports [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b]![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll be back with even more powerful weapons in the next patch.[/p][p]Stay cool this summer and sweep away those zombies![/p]

notes.title: Coming Soon! Patch - 1.2.0
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680818/abd5d56731f2ff30ce5fbb95aef4dc1f045ab7a1.png"][/img][/p][h2]Hello Survivors,[/h2][p][/p][p]This is Jebi, CM of [b]The DeadLine[/b]. [/p][p][/p][p]Patch 1.2.0 is scheduled for release on [b]August 4th[/b]![/p][p]
This update will introduce [b]new weapons[/b] and [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b].[/p][p]
Please check the full patch notes on the day of release for all the details![/p][p][/p][p][i]P.S. The addition of new weapons [b]might even shake up the Endless Mode leaderboard![/b][/i][/p]

notes.title: [Update] Welcome to The DeadLine's first patch – v.1.1.0!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680818/80758a895aa0f4802fabbc8135828c7d798f73f9.png"][/img][/p][h2]Hello Survivors[/h2][p]This is CM [b]Jebi[/b] from the development team of [i]The DeadLine[/i].[/p][p]How’s your summer going with all the zombies around?[/p][p]Welcome to [b]Patch 1.1.0[/b], the very first update for [i]The DeadLine[/i]![/p][p]In this patch, we’ve made some [b]campaign difficulty adjustments[/b] and introduced [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b] for a better experience.[/p][p][/p][h1]Balance Adjustments[/h1][p][/p][p][i]"We’ve seen many survivors getting overwhelmed by zombie hordes during the campaign.[/i][/p][p][i]To help more of you reach City Hall Station, we’re giving you a little boost."[/i][/p][p][/p][h3] Campaign Mode[/h3][list][*][p]Starting chip count: [b]1 → 5[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]A legendary weapon is now granted after completing the tutorial.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h1][p][/p][p][i]"We want to help you save even just a few seconds so you can focus more on surviving."[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Main Menu[/h3][list][*][p]You can now [b]skip the intro scene by pressing any button[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Menu button positions have been adjusted[/b] for better accessibility.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]It’s time to board the last subway once again, survivors.[/p][p]Head into the horde—[b]and begin your desperate struggle to survive![/b][/p]
